verification.command:
.venv-pantheon/bin/python3 <<'PY'
import importlib.util
import sys
import json

FILES = [
    ("test_pkt007_deployment_diff_contract", "services/control-plane/bff/test_pkt007_deployment_diff_contract.py"),
    ("test_ptj_004_trade_journal", "services/control-plane/bff/test_ptj_004_trade_journal.py"),
    ("test_srclive_overlay_contract", "services/control-plane/bff/test_srclive_overlay_contract.py"),
    ("test_tj_e2e_005_trade_journeys_read_api", "services/control-plane/bff/test_tj_e2e_005_trade_journeys_read_api.py"),
]

results = {}
overall_ok = True
for modname, path in FILES:
    before = set(sys.modules.keys())
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(modname, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[modname] = module
    try:
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        loaded_ok = True
        error = None
    except Exception as exc:
        loaded_ok = False
        error = repr(exc)
    after = set(sys.modules.keys())
    newly_loaded = after - before
    main_loaded = "main" in newly_loaded or "main" in sys.modules and modname not in ("main",)
    # more precise: did this module's load pull in top-level "main"
    main_pulled_in = "main" in (after - before)
    results[path] = {
        "loaded_ok": loaded_ok,
        "error": error,
        "main_module_pulled_in": main_pulled_in,
    }
    if not loaded_ok or main_pulled_in:
        overall_ok = False
    del sys.modules[modname]

print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if overall_ok else 1)
PY
